correctness.rationale: Poisson parity for disjoint intervals, joint self-similarity of inverse stable clock, dominated convergence, correctly normalized stable overshoot density via potential and Lévy measure, and complete regenerative gap casework prove the four-time formula. The strict connected example follows from exact arcsine pair values and positivity of a finite integral. Simulation and quadrature are auxiliary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Disjoint-window four-time heading memory is a physically motivated signature of long inactive plateaus missed by one- and two-time stationary statistics. The exact all-exponent four-time law and strict nonfactorization in a natural four-point configuration yield a testable, parameter-independent aging signature; no arbitrary slicing or purely numerical value is required.
